text.title: django-pytest — Worked Examples
text.summary: Unit tests, API integration tests, parametrize, and mocking external services. Also the pytest configuration block and a factory_boy factory.

section.title: Configuration

example.title: pyproject.toml pytest block
example.code: [tool.pytest.ini_options] DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE = "config.settings.test" python_files = ["test_*.py"] python_functions = ["test_*"] addopts = ["-v", "--tb=short", "--strict-markers", "-ra"] markers = [ "slow: deselect with '-m not slow'", "integration: integration tests", ]

section.note: `templates/conftest.py`: Minimal conftest with api_client, user, auth_client, and network-blocking fixture.

example.title: factory_boy DjangoModelFactory
example.code:
import factory from apps.users.models import User
class UserFactory(factory.django.DjangoModelFactory): class Meta: model = User email = factory.Sequence(lambda n: f"user{n}@example.com") name = factory.Faker("name")
example.note: `templates/factories.py`: DjangoModelFactory scaffolds for User and related models.

example.title: Arrange / Act / Assert with the db marker
example.note: One logical assertion group per test; fixtures supply the data (r2, r4, r10).

example.title: APIClient with force_authenticate
example.note: The authenticated client fixture uses force_authenticate; no login round-trip (r5).

example.title: Equivalence classes for password validation
example.note: Pure logic, no db marker; each failing row is reported by its parameters (r11).
